machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;START Starting Custom Script
G90; Absolute coordinates
M83; Extuder relative
M140 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set bed temperature
M141 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set build volume temp
T{initial_extruder_nr}
G27 P0 S0 T{initial_extruder_nr}; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T{initial_extruder_nr}; Park position to purge
G92 E0
M190 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set bed temperature
M109 S{material_print_temperature,initial_extruder_nr} T{initial_extruder_nr} ; Set T{initial_extruder_nr} nozzle for purge
G1 E10 F300 ; Initial Purge
G12 P0 S0 T{initial_extruder_nr}; Wipe tool
G27 P0 S0 T{initial_extruder_nr}; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T{initial_extruder_nr}; Park position to purge
;OPT_DYN_PRE(5|{material_print_temperature,0}|{material_standby_temperature,0}|5|{material_print_temperature,1}|{material_standby_temperature,1})
;END Starting Custom Script
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;START Ending Custom Script
M104 S0 T0 ; Hozzle T0 Off
M104 S0 T1 ; Hozzle T1 Off
G91 ; Relative coordinates
G1 Z5  F600  ; From last Z position move the bed down
G90; going back to absolute coordinates
M83 ; Ext Rel
G27 P0 S0 T0; ; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T0; Park position to purge
G1 E30 F250 ; Purge
G1 E-5.00  F300 ; Retract
G12 T0; Wipe
G27 P0 S0 T0; Park to avoid blade
G27 P0 S1 T0; Park position to purge
M140 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set bed temperature
M141 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set build volume temp
;END Ending Custom Script
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
